svg.text: Generated from owned cells and authored scene components. North / +Z is up. Grid: 4 m.
E escalator / S stair / R haul ramp
J true Jackpot / H Heavy sofa site
One or two featured sites per run;
at least one selected site is J.
Protected corridors and the service core form the permanent evacuation / haul route. Markers describe source authoring, before run pre-damage.
Decorative geometry, runtime shutters and loose scatter are omitted for readability; permanent doors are shown as white ticks.
